items.hypothesis: Long-length pool (29 s, unpaired): expected lower watched-full % and higher average watch seconds than the mid videos.
items.caption:
Before a full moon, people slept less.
In a 2021 field study, sleep started later and was shortest 3 to 5 days before a full moon. Total sleep varied by 46 to 58 minutes across the moon cycle in three communities in Argentina; the pattern appeared, but weaker, in 464 Seattle students. The authors suspect evening moonlight, and other studies are mixed. Next full moon: Mon Oct 26.
